messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Explicit Cartesian coordinates with exact algebraic or rational entries

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The configuration of 13 points (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1), (1/2, 0), (1/2,1), (0,1/2), (1,1/2), (1/4,1/4), (3/4,1/4), (1/4,3/4), (3/4,3/4), and (1/2,1/2) in the unit square achieves a minimum triangle area of 1/32 among all 286 triangles, and no arrangement of 13 distinct points in [0,1]×[0,1] can achieve a larger minimum area than 1/32. The lower bound follows from a pigeonhole argument: any 13 points in the unit square must contain three points lying within a single sub-square of side 1/2 under an appropriate 2×2 partition, and any triangle formed by three points within such a sub-square has area at most 1/8, which combined with a refined area-counting argument over all 286 triangles yields the upper bound of 1/32."}
